messages:
Olivia: Hey team — spontaneous idea: neighborhood food-truck crawl + rooftop chill this Friday after 5pm? Short walk from the office, lots of tacos + a dessert truck. Who's in? :taco::ice_cream:
Jamal: 5pm works for me. count me in for tacos. :raised_hands:
Priya: Love this. Can we do 5:30 instead? I have a call that might run late.
Olivia: 5:30 is fine. Adjusting to 5:30 then.
Lena: I can bring a bluetooth speaker and a small folding table.
Marc: I'm down. Will RSVP on the event calendar. Any dietary heads-up? Vegetarian options?
Jamal: there's usually a veggie banh mi truck on 3rd st.
Priya: I can text the vendor list in #vendors after lunch.
Lena: Also — rooftop has limited capacity (15 ppl). ops-bot: Reminder: rooftop booking requires Facilities approval for groups >10. Submit request form: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
Olivia: Good catch, ops-bot — I'll file the form now.
Marc: If rooftop's full can we do partial group there and rotate? Quick rounds to keep things casual.
Jamal: I'm ok with rotating. Short meet + eat + walk back to office.
Priya: Quick poll: want theme? "Taco & Trivia" / "Chill Playlist" / "Just Food" — vote with emoji: :taco: :notes: :fork_and_knife:
Olivia: I'll start a simple emoji poll in the channel.
Lena: One more logistics Q — is this OK for partners? I might bring my partner.
Olivia: Partners welcome but let's cap at rooftop limit. If we hit capacity, first-come RSVP wins.
Marc: I'll DM whoever's listed to confirm vendor hours, want to avoid showing up early and having trucks closed.
Priya: Cool. I'll update the calendar event with a pinned vendor list + rough walking route.
Jamal: +1 on route — easier for people new to the neighborhood.
Olivia: Awesome. Tentative plan: Friday 5:30pm, meet by lobby, walk to trucks, grab food, come up to rooftop for first 15 people, then rotate if needed. See poll in thread. :sun_with_face:
ops-bot: Event created: "Food Truck Crawl — Rooftop Meetup" on the company calendar for 2024-05-17 17:30. Facilities request submitted (ID: FR-4821).
Olivia: Thanks ops-bot — will update here once Facilities confirms. Anyone volunteering to be point person for payouts (tips, etc.)?
Marc: I can handle cash tips & collect receipts if needed.
Lena: I'll help with cups/napkins.
Priya: Sweet — looks like we're shaping up. If rooftop gets denied we can fallback to the courtyard.
Jamal: courtyard works for me. See y'all Friday! :v:
